stem.text: Leonardo da Vinci proposed a flying machine that would work like a screw to lift the pilot into the air. The ‘screw’ is rotated by the pilot.

stem.alt: Drawing of a machine: a large screw-shaped blade of two turns on a vertical shaft, supported by three legs on a circular base, with guy wires.

stem.text: The machine and the pilot together have a total mass of $120\,\text{kg}$.
Which useful output power must the pilot provide to move vertically upwards at a constant speed of $2.5\,\text{m s}^{-1}$?
